prompts.title: 电影短片图像和视频生成提示

prompts.content: スイーツを食べる女性の愛らしさを描く、全4カットのシネマティックなショートフィルム。温かみのあるカラーグレーディングと浅い被写界深度を用い、ASMR的な音響演出を重視する。構成は、パッケージを開ける手元のクローズアップから始まり、スイーツを口にする繊細な表情と咀嚼音、舞い散る粉や質感を捉えたスローモーションを含むミディアムショット、そして最後の一口を味わう満足げな余韻へとシームレスに展開する。視覚と聴覚の両面で「美味しさ」と「幸福感」を表現する。
prompts.translatedContent: 一部由四个镜头组成的电影短片，描绘了一位女性吃甜点时的魅力。影片采用暖色调和浅景深，并优先考虑 ASMR 般的音效设计。镜头无缝衔接，从特写双手打开包装，到中景捕捉她吃甜点时精致的表情和咀嚼声，包括捕捉散落的粉末和质感的慢动作镜头，最后到品尝完最后一口后的满足余韵。通过视觉和听觉两种方式，表达“美味”和“幸福”。

prompts.title: Nano Banana 2 提示词，用于创建人物和 3D 模型
prompts.description: 一个为 Nano Banana 2 设计的详细提示模板，旨在将输入的角色图像渲染成高端 PVC 手办和 3D 模型渲染图，重点关注产品摄影质量、纹理和技术细节。
prompts.content:
Masterpiece, best quality, (product photography:1.6), macro lens, 8k resolution, (photorealistic:1.5).

(Core Subject: High-End PVC Figure):
The EXACT character from the input image is rendered as a (high-end 1/7 scale PVC figure:1.6).
The figure stands on a clean wooden desk surface, out of the box.
(Texture & Quality - CRITICAL):
Premium matte plastic skin texture, glossy eye paint, intricate clothing folds, and precise airbrush shading.
The figure looks like a tangible, expensive collector's item (Good Smile Company or Alter quality).
A clear acrylic circular base supports the figure.

(Background: 3D Workspace):
Behind the figure, a computer monitor displays a (3D modeling software interface:1.5) (like Blender, Maya, or ZBrush).
On the screen: A (grey wireframe mesh or untextured clay render:1.5) of the SAME character is visible.
The screen represents the digital prototype of the physical figure.

(Surroundings):
The figure's retail packaging box stands vertically next to the figure, featuring the character art.
A blurred mechanical keyboard and mouse are visible in the background.
Soft, professional studio lighting illuminates the figure from above.

(Technical Tags): (depth of field:1.4), (bokeh:1.3), (PVC texture:1.5), (figure photography:1.4), (ray tracing), sharp focus on figure face.
(Negative prompt): (2D illustration:1.6), (anime style:1.5), (drawing), (sketch), (distorted face:1.5), (melted plastic), (bad painting), (messy desk), (screen off), (wrong character on screen), low quality, blurry.

杰作，最佳品质，（产品摄影：1.6），微距镜头，8k 分辨率，（超写实：1.5）。

（核心主题：高端 PVC 手办）：
输入图片中的 EXACT 角色被渲染成一个（高端 1/7 比例 PVC 手办：1.6）。
手办摆放在干净的木质桌面上，已从包装盒中取出。
（纹理与品质 - 至关重要）：
优质哑光塑料皮肤纹理，光泽眼部涂装，精致的服装褶皱，以及精准的喷枪阴影。
手办看起来像一个有形、昂贵的收藏品（Good Smile Company 或 Alter 品质）。
一个透明的圆形亚克力底座支撑着手办。

（背景：3D 工作区）：

屏幕上：可见同一角色的（灰色线框网格或未上色的粘土渲染：1.5）。

（周围环境）：
手办的零售包装盒垂直立在手办旁边，上面印有角色插画。
背景中可见模糊的机械键盘和鼠标。
柔和、专业的摄影棚灯光从上方照亮手办。

prompts.title: Nano Banana 2 的图像转熔岩石转换提示
prompts.description: 一个为 Nano Banana 2 设计的详细提示，将上传的图像转化为由冷却的火山熔岩雕刻而成的结构，保留主体轮廓的同时，应用多孔玄武岩的纹理、裂缝和微弱的炽热余烬效果。
prompts.content: Reinterpret the uploaded image as a structure carved from cooled volcanic lava rock. Preserve the main subject, silhouette, proportions, and recognizable structure of the original image, but transform all surfaces into porous basalt stone. The subject appears sculpted from hardened lava with rough textures, volcanic pores, cracks, and irregular rock surfaces typical of basalt formations. Some areas show subtle glowing embers deep within cracks while most of the rock appears dark and cooled. The environment feels volcanic and rugged with dramatic lighting emphasizing the texture of the stone. Cinematic geological photography, high detail, strong shadows, tactile rock textures. Negative constraints: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no duplicated objects, no smooth plastic surfaces, no cartoon rendering style.
